limitations: This is teacher-forced hidden-state replay, not a diffusion render or audio-domain score.
Only the 130 holdout records with recorded exact chunk alignment are included.
Complete non-overlapping windows define token metrics; a shifted final window fills replay-only tail frames.
The Serveurperso checkpoint was trained on a separate corpus and has no checkpoint-specific license declaration.

protocol.condition: official condition encoder with recorded chunk stitching
protocol.metric: cosine similarity per stitched condition-embedding latent frame
protocol.replay: teacher-forced official language model and RVQ depth decoder
